notes: 1.0.45: Tougher display link + all firmware updates in one place. Over Ethernet, if the display opens but stays silent (a stuck RS232-to-Ethernet converter), the app now reconnect-cycles the converter to clear its stale slot instead of failing; and a connected-but-silent link is no longer left sitting dead - it is refreshed automatically. The Display firmware update also moved to the Firmware tab, so the App, Controller, and Display updates are now together. (For a converter that keeps locking, set its Multi-host option to Yes.)
